references.text: Pharaoh ordered that straw should no longer be given to the Israelites for brickmaking, which explains the complaint in verse 16.
The slave drivers announced Pharaoh's command that the people themselves must gather straw, while the production requirement remained unchanged.
The Israelite overseers were beaten because production targets were not met, as mentioned here with the words 'your servants are being beaten'.
The background to the slavery in Egypt and the hard labor imposed on the Israelites.
The groaning and crying of the Israelites under slavery rose up to God, paralleling the complaint made here.
A complementary verse that explains Pharaoh's reasoning for the increased burden that led to the complaint.
